climatology_operator: Equal-weight mean of available paired year-month vector means, independently per native cell; both components use the same years.

scope_note: South Indian Ocean Current naming context at 80 E near 40 S, east of the Agulhas Return naming transition and west of the 90 E split. Near-surface peaks cannot inherit historical upper-1000 m transport identity; ACC, north subtropical front and eddy attribution remain unresolved.
layer: OSCAR2017.0 diagnostic near-surface velocity, nominal coordinate15 m; not direct 15 m instruments or a depth-resolved current.
time_convention: 1995–2016 equal-year calendar-month vector climatology. Each year-month cell needs five paired records; each climatology cell needs18 valid years. Width of this mean is not mean yearly width.
